A '''sub-dermal tracking chip''' was a type of tracking chip that was implanted underneath the target's skin. [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Gantrell]] and other [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]] had sub-dermal chips.
